note: The Egypt chapter is about the national ID and its law. It says Bedouin in remote Sinai face costly and dangerous travel to civil registration offices to register births, and that rural populations face obstacles to birth certificates, but states nothing on whether or how a birth or death is entered digitally. The other nine country chapters were read and give nothing on Egypt.
